fato_historico: 1998: Swissair Flight 111 crashes near Peggy's Cove, Nova Scotia; all 229 people on board are killed.
energia_do_dia: Today, your sensitive spirit may feel a deep connection to the tides of life. As you navigate these currents, consider how fragile yet precious each moment truly is. Like a memory drifting in the ocean, acknowledge the quiet sorrow of the past while embracing the radiant, hopeful light that guides your path forward toward peaceful shores today.
frase_do_dia: Hold every fleeting moment close as you drift through the vast, beautiful sea.
significado_numero: A powerful master number representing spiritual intuition and inner illumination.
conselho: Nurture your soul with gentle reflection and practice kindness toward yourself today.
